headline: AKS leads with a 100% 5‑day surge while MADAME posts a strong 13.95% daily gain.
market_take: Today's coverage shows mixed momentum across sectors. Property stocks are split, highlighted by AKS's 100% 5‑day jump versus CGD and RICHY declines. Construction materials saw a standout 50% intraday rise in GEL. The food sector was volatile, with MADAME up 13.95% and XBIO experiencing a -12.50% opening gap followed by a +14.29% intraday rally. Several capital‑change and restructuring filings were recorded, adding context to the price moves.

sector_notes.note: MADAME surged 13.95% (intraday +11.36%) and XBIO opened down 12.50% before rallying 14.29% intraday; CHAO filed share‑repurchase notices.
AKS posted a 100% 5‑day gain; PF jumped 25% intraday; CGD and RICHY fell 9.09% and 6.67% respectively, with RICHY reporting a debenture‑holder meeting.
GEL recorded a 50% intraday rise; PPP and DCON declined modestly; TTCL added a 33.3% 5‑day gain and disclosed an organizational restructuring.
M‑STOR fell 18.37%; ISSARA and M‑PAT each rose about 4.5%; TNPF and M‑PAT showed -100% opening gaps; TPRIME filed a capital‑decrease.

SQ opened down 10.53% and rebounded 11.76% intraday; NL spiked 9.8σ in volume with an 8.57% price gap and -9.21% intraday move; TPOLY posted an -8.33% gap and +9.09% intraday rise; multiple share‑repurchase filings from BJCHI.
TRUBB rose 4.72% and PPPM slipped 4.55%; M‑PAT added a 4.55% gain.
